newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus jumps 7.4 pct on good May data.
newsitem.headline: Optimus jumps 7.4 pct on good May data.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA on Thursday jumped 7.4 percent in moderate trade to 102 zlotys on strong May earnings results, analysts said.
On Wednesday Optimus said its May net profit rose to 6.6 million zlotys from one million zlotys last year.
Analysts said the strong buying of the stock after price fixing could point to another gain on Friday.

The only main market stock to outperform Optimus on Thursday, Polifarb Cieszyn, rose 9.4 percent, likely helped by its lifting May net profit to 4.7 from 3.1 million zlotys, analysts said.--Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
